title: The circulant Hadamard conjecture
summary: We prove the circulant Hadamard conjecture: a real circulant Hadamard matrix has order 1 or 4. As a consequence, Barker sequences of length greater than one exist exactly at lengths 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 13, proving the Barker-sequence conjecture.
family_title: The circulant Hadamard and Barker-sequence conjectures

review.reason: Proves that real circulant Hadamard matrices exist only in orders 1 and 4, with Barker sequence consequences.
